messages:
alice: deploybot paused release r-2026-03-07-2254 — deploybot reason: env key suffix mismatch for 'inference-cache'. see deploybot log below.

dev-deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT: RELEASE PAUSED. reason=KEY_SUFFIX_MISMATCH. affected keys detected in staging vs prod: 'inference.cachePrefix' (staging) != 'inference.cache_prefix' (prod). preflight failed: 1 check.

carla: yea, that rename came in with the helm cleanup last week. staging overlay didn't get updated.

ben: can we hotpatch staging values to match prod? what's the blast radius if we do during the change window?

dinesh: quick question — did this actually hit prod already? I thought we had pinned the model variant earlier in the release so prod might be reading a different path.

alice: @carla can you confirm the exact values file and whether a hotpatch is low-risk within the 2h change window?

carla: values path: charts/inference/values-staging.yaml. change is a simple key rename. Example fragment from staging:

```
# charts/inference/values-staging.yaml (before)
inference:
  cachePrefix: "s3://redwood-cache/staging/"
```

prod uses:

```
# charts/inference/values.yaml (prod)
inference:
  cache_prefix: "s3://redwood-cache/prod/"
```

ben: deploybot flagged it because the service's env interpolation for model variant reads the cache key; when it's missing the service falls back to default bucket and we see huge latency + cost.

carla: right. not catastrophic but breaks some e2e traffic routes. I think hotpatching staging to match prod naming is safe.

alice: options: 1) hotpatch staging values and re-run preflight, 2) rollback/pin model to previous variant that uses legacy key, 3) continue with manual fallback and monitor. We need the decision and a rollback plan in the notes.

dinesh: I lean hotpatch. smallest blast radius and fixes parity for future releases.

dev-deploy-bot: suggested command snippet for ops: 
```
kubectl -n staging patch cm inference-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"values.yaml":"<updated-contents>"}}'
```

carla: I'll open a quick PR and apply the patch with a forced apply since we're in the release window. PR: github.com/redwood/charts/pull/314 (hotpatch: align key name cache_prefix)

ben: for safety I'll pin the model variant in the release manifest to v3.0 (the fallback-safe variant) until we confirm canary metrics are green.

alice: rollback criteria for release notes: if error rate > 1.5% OR latency p95 > 600ms sustained for 15 minutes, rollback to previous deployment. Add that to the release notes and notify oncall.

carla: applied patch to staging configmap and synced Helm overlay. re-running preflight... preflight output: 
- env key check: PASS
- k/v path: normalized
- healthchecks: PASS

devops-oncall: oncall here — I'll watch telemetry, created temp channel #prod-telemetry-2260 and set alert thresholds to the ones alice listed.

alice: ok @dev-deploy-bot, resume release when parity checks pass.

dev-deploy-bot: RELEASEBOT: resume requested by alice. re-running parity checks... checks OK. proceeding with canary rollout plan: 10% (5m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (15m). monitoring enabled.

ben: moving to canary. updating release notes: "Hotpatch staging values to restore cache key naming; temporarily pinned model variant to v3.0; monitors + rollback thresholds set."

dinesh: logging decision: hotpatch applied. follow-up postmortem will include a new preflight test for key naming normalization and a chart-merge lint rule.

carla: canary metrics look stable after 10m: error rate 0.12% (below threshold), p95 240ms. promoting to 50%.

devops-oncall: watching — no alerts so far.

dev-deploy-bot: Canary succeeded. Promoting to 100%. RELEASE COMPLETE.

alice: thanks team. action items: 1) postmortem doc in eng-releases retrospective, 2) add key-name normalization check to preflight, 3) backfill staging overlays for any chart renames. I'll add all items to the release notes and assign owners.

ben: noted. I'll revert model pin after full promotion and run a quick sanity for variant v3.1-quant in a controlled canary next week.

carla: PR merged and the hotpatch will be included in the release notes. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
